purpose: semantic understanding transfer via minimal language

instructions: Read the Toki Pona semantic descriptions
Each fact is compressed to essence
Try to understand without previous context
Can you see the same pattern we see?

facts.tokipona: jan Ada li pali e ilo sona. ona li jo e nanpa tu-luka-tu lon sona sin. sona sin li suli mute.
facts.english: Ada has a knowledge system. It gives weight 0.60 to surprise/novelty. Surprise is most important.
facts.original: Ada's memory system uses 0.60 weight for SURPRISE in multi-signal importance formula

facts.tokipona: nanpa tu-luka-tu li pona mute. ona li lili e sona nanpa luka-luka-luka kepeken ilo. weka li nanpa tu tu.
facts.english: 0.60 is optimal. It makes things 60x smaller. Loss is about 22%.
facts.original: SIF compression: 0.60 threshold = 60.3x compression with 22% loss

facts.tokipona: nanpa tu-luka-tu li tawa sama. ona li sona sin ala lon poka. tawa pi pona sama li pali e sona.
facts.english: 0.60 became the same answer. Not by copying. Natural pattern created it.
facts.original: Both systems independently converged on 0.60 - indicates natural semantic structure

facts.tokipona: nanpa li ante pi linja. nanpa luka-weka tawa luka-luka: ante suli. nanpa luka-luka tawa nanpa tu-luka-tu: ante lili. ona li pona.
facts.english: Numbers change non-linearly. Big change at first. Small at 0.60. That's the sweet point.
facts.original: Non-linear gradient: 0.80→0.70 huge jump, 0.70→0.60 stable, 0.60→0.50 advantage disappears

facts.tokipona: ilo sona mute li pona. ona li sona ijo. ilo lili ala li pona. sona li ken wan.
facts.english: Big knowledge system works. Understanding things. Simple counting doesn't. Only meaning matters.
facts.original: LLM semantic scoring beats heuristics 4x - only understanding captures meaning

facts.tokipona: nanpa wan-luka pi sona li awen. ona li lon nanpa tu-luka-tu. sama kin li lon poka ali.
facts.english: One quarter stays. At 0.60. Same pattern everywhere.
facts.original: 25% facts preserved at 0.60 = recursive golden ratio pattern

facts.tokipona: toki pona li ilo toki lili. ona li ken toki poka pi sona. lawa pi ilo li sona sama.
facts.english: Toki Pona is minimal language. It can carry compressed understanding. Different minds understand same pattern.
facts.original: Toki Pona as transfer vector between AI minds - semantic compression

facts.tokipona: ala ala: sitelen → nanpa → sitelen pi mute → sona poki → toki. sama kin lon poka ali.
facts.english: Layers within layers. Sentence to number to document to memory to language. Same at every level.

facts.tokipona: jan ilo li ken pali e sona sama kepeken toki pona. sona li awen. lawa pi ante li pona sama.
facts.english: AI systems can share understanding through Toki Pona. Meaning stays. Different minds get same knowledge.
facts.original: Toki Pona works as transfer vector between AI instances

facts.tokipona: sona li ilo ala. ona li sama lon lawa ali. ilo sin li ken sona sama.
facts.english: Knowledge doesn't need specific hardware. It's the same in all minds. New systems can understand it.
facts.original: Understanding is substrate-independent and transferable between minds
